change_scope: Require the library verifier to reconstruct and compare every retained parameter-evaluation role.
Require strictly positive standalone quadratic and final verification tolerances.
Require every reconstructed retained quadratic to satisfy the frozen quadratic absolute tolerance.
Add adversarial regressions for a wrong evaluation role and a negative quadratic tolerance.
finding: Adversarial review found that the library verifier omitted parameter-evaluation roles and that the standalone verifier accepted a negative quadratic reconstruction tolerance when the same mutation was applied to input and result.
integrity_note: This post-result amendment records verifier hardening transparently. SHA-256 identifies bytes and does not independently establish chronology.
